recipes.title: Grilled Chili Lime Wings (homemade chili-lime seasoning)

items.i: dried red chiles (guajillo or ancho), stemmed and seeded
bunch cilantro, dried (or 2 tbsp dried cilantro)

steps: Soak the dried chiles in hot water until soft, then scrape out the pulp into a paste.
Spread the chile paste, lime zest and cilantro on trays and dry in a dehydrator or the oven on its lowest setting until completely dry and brittle.
Grind the dried chile, lime zest and cilantro with the salt, garlic powder and onion powder into a fine seasoning.
Pat the wings dry, toss with a little oil and coat generously in the chili-lime seasoning.
Grill over medium indirect heat, turning occasionally, for 35–45 minutes until the skin is crisp and charred in spots and the meat reaches 175°F (80°C).
Squeeze over fresh lime juice and serve.
recipes.notes: Estimated recipe: the video is music only with no amounts, so quantities, times and macros are estimates. A shortcut: use a store-bought chili-lime seasoning (like Tajín) plus extra lime zest.
